finalStatusDetail: Gate 1 licensing audit complete. MapTiler 403 root cause found (Allowed User-Agent substring 'Ora'; native OkHttp/Dart UAs rejected). PoC now sends User-Agent Ora-MapLibre-PoC/1.0 via setHttpHeaders + preflight. SM-A325F physical proof shows Lahore Gulberg vector basemap, pitched 3D building extrusions, custom markers, blue display-only route, orbit camera, pan, leave/reopen. MapLibre GL FPS still NOT_MEASURED (SurfaceView not in gfxinfo). Keep Google production. No production migration. Absolute zero third-party branding on final map is NOT satisfied by MapTiler street tiles without Sales written permission + unsuitable Planet Lite.
